difference: Previous GROUPOID.HALFDENSITY.GLOBAL.01 and KNESER.GROUPOID.HALFDENSITY.01 concerned unimodular Haar groupoids. This separately fixes an actual finite character readout on primitive source-intersection lattices and proves its exact normalization. It is not the circular SOURCECONTRACTOR target-norm insertion, nor a finite Weil-window majorant. The oblique projection rule is source-derived but must pass the actual D2 square, not just a fitted first value. No historical killed global route is revived.
label: finite-character-normalized-half-form-and-oblique-gain-test
next_test: Define half-form transport on source-moved active planes E->gE with the restricted complex-volume cocycle j(g,E), and test j versus full Nrd, common domains and composition on a,D2,D2^2,qA,qB. Separately assess whether the new TOE marked-transition rigidity can be stated before selecting a target arithmetic generator in an unbounded compatible source family.
object: On the actual source-stable CM column lattice use E_g=im(g-I), L_E=L intersect E_g and C_g=coker(A_g^T-I), of order delta_g^2. Test the definite proposal that the canonical normalized pair e0 and u_C=|C|^-1/2 sum e_c realizes the existing half-form target chi_g=sqrt(n_g)/delta_g, or that multiplying this overlap by the norm of the canonical oblique active spectral projector supplies the missing sqrt(n_g). Test D2, its actual square, q3,qA,qB with the inherited metric and primitive intersection lattices. The first proposal gives1/delta, fails for all five, and is impossible for any contractive normalized readout at D2 since chi=sqrt2>1. The projector rule matches D2 but fails D2^2 and all three block sources. Return exact sequences for (A-I)(A+I) preserve canonical coherent overlaps but do not imply multiplicative scalar source traces.
obligations: A replacement must specify a non-normalized or determinant-line trace and derive its normalization on the same source, not insert sqrt(n)
Transport active spaces, metrics and domains under a,D2,D2^2,qA,qB without a fixed noncovariant passive projection
Distinguish restricted complex-volume cocycle j(g,E) from full reduced norm n(g), and prove any required identification
Retain all-place compatibility, Gamma and pole terms, zero independence and global signed Weil positivity as open obligations
scope: Written finite Fourier and normalized contraction proofs, exact source-specific active-metric and full finite quotient controls. A bounded normalized-state/contractive-observable identification and the precise projector-norm correction are refuted, not unnormalized positive functionals, CP maps without normalization, ordinary Fock traces, determinant-line valued or distributional traces. No full source-algebra intertwiner, physical norm time, all-place pairing or RH proof.
stop_condition: Stop if a normalized amplitude greater than1 is accepted; if oblique D2 gain is generalized without its square; if return counts are replaced by n^2 covering degrees; if the Fock trace is called refuted by a bound for normalized states; or if finite native time-generator rigidity is identified with all-prime logarithmic norm time.
